name: Blackbox AI
tagline: Blackbox AI is a code-focused AI assistant available as a VS Code extension, web editor, and standalone app. It provides real-time code completion, a chat interface for asking coding questions, and the ability to extract code from images and videos — useful when reading tutorials or Stack Overflow screenshots. With a large free tier and support for 20+ programming languages, it has attracted millions of users as an accessible entry point to AI-assisted development.
